author.title: Meet the author
author.shortBio: Roberto Luna is an entrepreneur and thinker who turned negotiation into a deeply human act: less war, more compassion, words that build and do not break.
fullBio: Roberto Luna is a contemporary entrepreneur, leader, and thinker who has made negotiation a profoundly human practice. Beyond contracts and numbers, his work focuses on a radical idea for the business world: negotiation is, above all, an act of consciousness, language, and compassion.

With a vision that blends philosophy, business experience, and emotional sensitivity, Roberto proposes a new way of dialoguing with others and with oneself. In 'Negociando Bonito' (Negotiating Beautifully), he shares reflections born from both leadership and his personal journey: the importance of listening, choosing words well, understanding the other, and cultivating relationships based on respect and empathy.

Throughout the book, Roberto invites us to see negotiation not as a battle to be won, but as a space to be nurtured. He speaks of compassionate leadership, the power of language, the ability to adapt like water, and the urgent need to humanize professional environments without losing effectiveness or results.

His philosophy holds that the best agreements are not born from imposition, but from understanding; not from fear, but from clarity; not from the ego, but from presence. For him, to negotiate well is also to live better.
'Negociando Bonito' is an extension of his way of inhabiting the world: with attention, with intention, and with a deep faith that conversations can transform lives.

extracts: Clarity is not a starting point, it is a result. It is built.
Listen to understand, not to respond. That is the key.
Negotiating beautifully is about caring for the relationship without betraying your intention.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
content: Welcome to Negociando Bonito. Your privacy is of the utmost importance to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website.

1. INFORMATION COLLECTION. We collect information about you in various ways. The information we may collect on the Site includes: a) Personal Data: Personally identifiable information, such as your name and email address, that you voluntarily provide to us when you sign up for our contact form. You are under no obligation to provide us with personal information of any kind, however, your refusal to do so may prevent you from using certain features of the Site. b) Derivative Data: Information our servers automatically collect when you access the Site, such as your IP address, your browser type, your operating system, your access times, and the pages you have viewed directly before and after accessing the Site. This site uses Google Analytics to collect this data anonymously.

2. USE OF YOUR INFORMATION. Having accurate information about you permits us to provide you with a smooth, efficient, and customized experience. Specifically, we may use information collected about you via the Site to: a) Respond to your contact requests. b) Compile anonymous statistical data and analysis for use internally or with third parties. c) Increase the efficiency and operation of the Site.

3. DISCLOSURE OF YOUR INFORMATION. We will not sell, distribute, or lease your personal information to third parties. We may disclose your information if required by law, to protect our rights, or in the event of a business transfer.

4. TRACKING TECHNOLOGIES. a) Cookies and Web Beacons: We may use cookies, web beacons, tracking pixels, and other tracking technologies on the Site to help customize the Site and improve your experience. This site uses Google Analytics, a web analytics service provided by Google, Inc. Google Analytics uses cookies to help the website analyze how users use the site. You can learn more about how Google uses data when you use our partners' sites or apps at www.google.com/policies/privacy/partners/. b) Interest-Based Advertising: Additionally, we may use third-party cookies for advertising purposes. You may opt out of interest-based advertising through the tools provided by the Digital Advertising Alliance.

5. SECURITY OF YOUR INFORMATION. We use administrative, technical, and physical security measures to help protect your personal information. While we have taken reasonable steps to secure the personal information you provide to us, please be aware that despite our efforts, no security measures are perfect or impenetrable, and no method of data transmission can be guaranteed against any interception or other type of misuse.

6. USER RIGHTS (GDPR & CCPA). If you are a resident of the European Economic Area (EEA) or California, you have certain data protection rights. We aim to take reasonable steps to allow you to correct, amend, delete, or limit the use of your Personal Data. If you wish to be informed what Personal Data we hold about you and if you want it to be removed from our systems, please contact us at robluna.mkt@gmail.com.

7. LINKS TO THIRD-PARTY WEBSITES. The Site may contain links to third-party websites and applications of interest, including advertisements and external services, that are not affiliated with us. Once you have used these links to leave the Site, any information you provide to these third parties is not covered by this Privacy Policy, and we cannot guarantee the safety and privacy of your information.

8. POLICY FOR CHILDREN. We do not knowingly solicit information from or market to children under the age of 13. If we learn that we have collected personal information from a child under age 13 without verification of parental consent, we will delete that information from our records promptly.

9. CHANGES TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY. We reserve the right to make changes to this Privacy Policy at any time and for any reason. We will alert you about any changes by updating the “Last updated” date of this Privacy Policy.
10. CONTACT US. If you have questions or comments about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: robluna.mkt@gmail.com.
